entities.summary: Andrius Palionis is a Lithuanian politician. He served as Minister of Agriculture in the cabinet of Prime Minister Saulius Skvernelis from 7 August 2019 to 11 December 2020. He is affiliated with the Social Democratic Labour Party of Lithuania.
